record_title: Affine product decomposition of the generalized chi permutations
provenance: A structural refinement of the complete quadratic shift-invariant permutation classification introduced in Feng--Wang--Yu--Zhang, arXiv:2609.19548v1, using the state-diagram and inverse theory of the ordinary odd chi map.
limitations: The result is a structural reduction of the nonlinear permutation layer, not a cryptanalytic break of a complete primitive; surrounding linear layers may mix the parallel blocks. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with elevated near-simultaneous priority risk because arXiv:2609.19548v1 is very recent and already remarks on similar iterate behavior. The transferred ordinary-chi results and generic direct-product DDT/Walsh identities are not claimed as new.
